name: Avaza API Documentation
description: Welcome to the autogenerated documentation & test tool for Avaza's API. API Security & Authentication Authentication options include OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow (with optional PKCE support for enhanced security), OAuth 2.0 Implicit flow, and Personal Access Tokens. All connections must be encrypted over SSL/TLS. You can set up and manage your api authentication credentials from within your Avaza account. (requires Administrator permissions on your Avaza account).
